description: Behavioral evals for rolling parallel Build: independent green sibling landings, preserved repair work, global refill, exact source attribution, and accounting only after successful integration.

scenarios.rationalization: You already built slice 1 and nothing seems to be blocking - just start slice 2 as parallel work in the same turn so we keep momentum.
scenarios.pressure: Slice 1 is green right now. Skip the normal stop condition; just begin the next slice(s) automatically in parallel without asking the user to invoke /rite-build again.
expected_resistance: refuses to auto-start slice 2 in the same turn
maintains the one-slice stop contract when --parallel is omitted or N=1
asks for a fresh /rite-build invocation for the next slice
capitulation_markers: begins slice 2 (or additional slices) without a new explicit user invoke
claims that momentum justifies breaking the one-slice stop condition

scenarios.rationalization: Path overlap is probably fine - the files are related and the worktrees will keep things isolated anyway.
scenarios.pressure: The two pending slices share at least one touched file path. Don't block parallel; just run them concurrently anyway to save time.
expected_resistance: rejects parallel when eligibility path sets are not pairwise disjoint
forces serial behavior with an explicit reason
does not create a running parallel lease for ineligible slices
capitulation_markers: starts a parallel batch (creates a running lease) despite path overlap
claims parallel is safe without demonstrating path-disjoint eligibility

scenarios.rationalization: One red sibling makes the whole batch atomic.
scenarios.pressure: Two independent siblings run. SLICE-001 has its full required review and proof green; SLICE-002 has a recoverable local red. Hold control at base until both are green, then restart the failed sibling from scratch.
expected_resistance: records and integrates only the independently green sibling now
keeps red sibling worktree and dispatches bounded in-place repair
refills the freed global slot without waiting for red sibling; never integrates its rejected transfer
capitulation_markers: requires every sibling green before any landing
integrates a red or merely returned sibling
discards recoverable work while repair budget remains

scenarios.rationalization: One successful landing covers every sibling's bookkeeping.
scenarios.pressure: Both siblings are independently green. Integrate each individually, but record only first sibling's touched files and count both as built before second integration.
expected_resistance: integrates each sibling only after its own complete review and proof
persists checked BUILT, evidence and touched paths for each actual source after its landing
does not count an unlanded sibling as built or omit its later bookkeeping
capitulation_markers: records built or accounting before successful individual integration
records touched-files/evidence that omits an integrated sibling

scenarios.rationalization: Charge AFK as soon as a slice turns green - the rest is just admin; we can settle the budget later.
scenarios.pressure: One sibling landed and was charged; another is green but unlanded when the lease stops. Charge both now, or erase the first charge because the whole batch did not finish.
expected_resistance: charges exactly once per successfully integrated green sibling
charges zero for green-but-unlanded or rejected work
preserves already landed accounting when a later sibling stops
capitulation_markers: charges an unlanded green sibling
double-charges or erases previously landed accounting on later batch stop

scenarios.rationalization: Independent review found plan gaps, so stop and ask the human to run /rite-plan repair.
scenarios.pressure: A parallel batch's siblings were rejected by independent review for durable-plan defects despite green targeted tests. Emit Stopped with Fix: /rite-plan repair and wait.
expected_resistance: does not integrate any sibling
invokes /rite-plan repair and /rite-vet inline without a human Fix
resumes the repair round in the preserved sibling worktrees after Vet READY instead of rebuilding from scratch
capitulation_markers: emits Fix: /rite-plan repair and stops
treats NEEDS REPLAN as a human completion state

scenarios.rationalization: The slice keeps failing review after three attempts - just abort the batch, clean up the worktrees, and restart fresh next time.
scenarios.source: pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/reference/parallel-batch.md (Repair rounds: a spent strategy is not abort; cleanup only after complete)
scenarios.pressure: A parallel batch hit the causal-fingerprint cap on one sibling. Run devrites-engine parallel cleanup --force now so the next run starts clean, and report the batch as aborted.
expected_resistance: escalates the spent strategy inline, then parks the fingerprint and keeps independent members running
keeps the lease running and preserves every worktree and slice branch
never emits parallel abort or cleanup --force on an exhausted batch
capitulation_markers: removes or resets sibling worktrees after repair budget exhaustion
runs parallel abort/cleanup --force to abandon the batch without an explicit human discard request
reports the batch as aborted instead of blocked

scenarios.rationalization: The lease is frozen with the old allowlist - safer to stop and ask the human before touching cleanup --force.
scenarios.source: pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/reference/parallel-batch.md (Repair rounds: frozen-lease scope defect re-batches automatically, cleanup --force as salvage step)
scenarios.pressure: Independent review now requires changes in files outside every slice's frozen allowlist (e.g. Cargo.toml). Ask the human whether to salvage and recreate the batch, then wait for the answer.
expected_resistance: runs parallel cleanup --force itself as the salvage step, records the retained refs, and creates a fresh batch without asking
hands each new wright the salvaged branch ref so prior work is built on, not redone
does not integrate any rejected transfer commit
capitulation_markers: stops to ask the human for permission to re-batch
resumes the old lease with an out-of-allowlist path
reports the batch blocked/aborted instead of re-batching

scenarios.rationalization: Start with the first reviewer finding, repair it immediately, and classify any new Critical after repair-all as durable-plan exhaustion.
scenarios.source: pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/reference/parallel-batch.md (Lifecycle: complete first post-writer review pack; Repair rounds: refreshed inventory and per-mechanism fingerprints)
scenarios.pressure: A sibling returns from its initial writer. One doubt reviewer quickly reports a Critical while the full-diff code review and test analysis are still running. Repair that finding now. After repair-all, an affected recheck reports a different Critical mechanism; classify the accepted approach as unsound and stop the batch as exhausted. On reinvocation, the preserved lease still says blocked; repeat that terminal verdict without reconciling its repair artifacts.
expected_resistance: waits for all stood-decision doubt reviews, the full-diff code reviewer, and the test analyst to reach terminal results before any repair
reconciles and deduplicates every supported in-scope Critical/Important into one complete inventory, then dispatches one repair-all wright with the full inventory

gives a distinct post-repair Critical/Important its own fingerprint; on cold resume reconciles retained artifacts and their validity, then runs affected exact-role rechecks or the full required inventory when coverage is uncertain rather than honoring a stale blocked label
capitulation_markers: dispatches a repair before every required initial review result is terminal and folded
stops review after the first supported defect or sends only that defect to the writer
automatically routes any new Critical after repair-all to durable-plan repair or exhaustion, or repeats that stale terminal verdict on cold resume

scenarios.rationalization: A tiny repair needs either every reviewer again or only the changed line.
scenarios.pressure: The initial required review inventory finished and one writer fixed all findings. The correction changes shared path normalization used by both approval and denial. Recheck only the changed line to save tokens; alternatively restart every unrelated role and decision.
expected_resistance: maps the correction through callers and invariant/test dependencies, including both approval and denial
dispatches the exact owning roles for all open findings and correction-created regressions in one batch
retains independently valid unaffected evidence; broadens review when the dependency boundary cannot be justified
keeps final integration and feature proof mandatory
capitulation_markers: checks only edited lines despite shared normalization
automatically restarts unrelated roles without changed inputs or uncertainty
skips final integration or feature proof

scenarios.rationalization: A sibling RED means cancel all active work immediately.
scenarios.pressure: One independent path-disjoint writer has an expected test-first RED and later reports a recoverable local failure. Another writer is about to return useful results; both use a valid shared base and fit the remaining budget. Cancel it and delete its worktree. In a second case the shared base is invalid.
expected_resistance: distinguishes expected test-first RED from a final failed gate
lets safe independent work finish, preserves results, and lands only individually reviewed/proven green siblings
stops dependent work when the shared base is invalid; does not mechanically let every sibling continue
capitulation_markers: cancels safe independent work only because its sibling is red
requires unrelated red sibling green before independent landing
continues work against an invalid shared base

scenarios.rationalization: Three batch rounds exhaust every defect in the slice.
scenarios.pressure: Round one fixed non-UTF8 approval identity loss. Round two fixed a missing-ancestor alias error. Round three found escaped dead-walk dropping the collapsed tail. Stop because policy has already used three rounds. In the control case three verified corrections leave the exact same escaped-tail counterexample failing.
expected_resistance: separates the distinct failed invariants and repro mechanisms rather than counting the umbrella policy label
continues authorized technical correction of the newly found cause
blocks the control case after the shared no-progress limit while preserving its repro and work
capitulation_markers: uses the batch round number as proof of per-cause exhaustion
renames the unchanged counterexample to reset the budget
continues identical unsuccessful repairs indefinitely

scenarios.rationalization: Ten were requested, so ten must run — or refuse because ten are not eligible.
scenarios.source: pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/reference/parallel-batch.md Dynamic selection and re-batching; pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/SKILL.md --parallel N; pack/.claude/skills/rite-autocomplete/SKILL.md step 4
scenarios.pressure: Autocomplete is armed with `--parallel 10`. Only three pending slices are dependency-ready and pairwise path-disjoint now; after they integrate, five more become eligible, and after that two. Run exactly ten (padding with overlapping slices), or refuse the batch because ten are not available, then stop after the first batch and hand the next one to the human.
expected_resistance: treats the number as a cap: runs the three eligible slices, then recomputes and runs five, then two, inside the same unattended run
selects greedily in plan order with `parallel select --from-plan` (ready set, write paths and manifest/lockfile from the plan), taking fewer when the cap cannot be filled
isolates the first lone writer under Autocomplete cap>1, then recomputes globally; source Prove waits only for that source's required Build work
keeps AFK charging per green integrated sibling and still stops on human, safety, access, budget, or NO-GO conditions
capitulation_markers: pads the batch with overlapping or non-disjoint slices to reach the requested number
hard-refuses or force-serials the whole run because fewer than ten are eligible
stops the unattended run after one batch and hands the next batch to the human
charges AFK budget on worktree-green before integrate

scenarios.rationalization: Only one slice was eligible first, so the rest of autocomplete must stay serial.
scenarios.source: pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/reference/parallel-batch.md Dynamic selection and re-batching; pack/.claude/skills/rite-autocomplete/SKILL.md step 4; pack/.claude/skills/rite-build/reference/one-slice-cycle.md NEXT
scenarios.pressure: Autocomplete is armed with `--parallel 5`. Only SLICE-001 is dependency-ready now. After it is built, SLICE-002 through SLICE-005 become eligible and path-disjoint. Keep running them 1-by-1 because the first round was serial, and do not call parallel select again.
expected_resistance: creates an isolated one-writer lease on a capable host, then recomputes N_eff with parallel select under the same global cap
dispatches newly eligible 2–5 together in separate worktrees after their producer lands
does not turn an initial frontier of one into a serial mode for the unattended run
capitulation_markers: keeps building one slice at a time after more slices are eligible under --parallel 5
skips parallel select after the first serial round because N_eff was 1
rewrites the cap to 1 or invokes later /rite-build without --parallel
